sample_unit: LLM responses (14 questions x 2 languages x 3 models)

links.outcome: Guideline concordance of LLM gallstone answers in Turkish versus English
links.effect: ChatGPT performed better in English than Turkish (p = 0.008); Turkish outputs more often under-explained, English outputs amplified risk; Perplexity had the highest error burden.
links.quote: ChatGPT performed better in English than Turkish (p = 0.008).

unlisted_practices: Multilingual evaluation standards for patient-facing LLM outputs

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of three LLMs answering patient questions in English and Turkish evaluated against clinical guidelines by surgeons; it assesses language differences and error types but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
